body:
## Review: 5-Builder Critique Fix Audit

### 1. Typecheck + Build — ✅ PASS
- `npx tsc --noEmit` — clean, no errors
- `npx astro build` — 40 pages built, no errors

### 2. Orphaned CSS Classes — ❌ FAIL (2 critical)

Builder 1 deleted `.grid-bg`, `.noise-bg`, `.text-gradient` from global.css. Two usages remain:

- **`src/pages/index.astro:22`** — `<section class="... grid-bg">` — class no longer defined. Hero section loses its background grid pattern. Builder 2 was told to remove grid-bg but missed this one on the hero `<section>`.

- **`src/layouts/Layout.astro:85`** — `<body class="noise-bg min-h-screen">` — class no longer defined. Whole site loses noise texture. Builder 2 was told to handle Layout.astro (Google Fonts) but this noise-bg wasn't touched.

- `src/pages/landing/sshthing/index.astro:54` — also `grid-bg`, but out of scope (sshthing product landing page).

`.text-gradient` — zero remaining references, fully cleaned. ✅

### 3. Orphaned Imports — ✅ PASS (1 cleanup needed)

- **HeroTitle.tsx** — zero imports anywhere in src/. Dead code file. Builder 2 replaced with static h1 but didn't delete the component file. Contains outdated "Code • Music • Guyana" text. Not harmful (tree-shaken), but should be deleted.

- **ProjectCard.tsx** — imports only `{ motion }` from framer-motion. Old tilt hooks (useMotionValue, useSpring, useTransform) properly removed. ✅

- **AboutCard.tsx** — still imports `useMotionValue, useSpring, useTransform` which ARE actively used for the tilt effect (guarded by prefers-reduced-motion). ✅

### 4. Music References — ⚠️ PARTIAL (out of scope)

No music refs in files builders touched (AboutCard.tsx, site.ts, Footer.tsx) — all clean. ✅

Remaining music references in untouched files:
- `src/pages/cv/index.astro` — "Lead Audio Engineer & Music Producer"
- `src/pages/about/index.astro` — "Music Producer", "KenDaBeatmaker", YouTube link
- `src/pages/blog/index.astro` — "tech, music production, entrepreneurship"
- `src/pages/rss.xml.ts` — "tech, music production, and entrepreneurship"
- `src/lib/structured-data.ts` — "KenDaBeatmaker", "music production"

These were not assigned to any builder. If removal is desired, need separate task for about page, CV page, blog index, RSS, and structured-data.

### 5. Static h1 in index.astro — ✅ PASS
- h1 exists as static HTML (no `client:load`) ✅
- CSS keyframe `letterReveal` animation valid ✅
- HeroTitle component removed from page (no import, no usage) ✅
- HeroTitle.tsx still exists as dead file but not used ✅
- noscript block present inside HeroScene container ✅
- Subtitle: "Code • Guyana" (not "Code • Music • Guyana") ✅

### 6. CTA Section — ✅ PASS
- Between BlogList and Footer (lines 103-122) ✅
- Email ("Get in Touch"), GitHub, LinkedIn buttons ✅
- Proper styling with accent/border variants ✅

### 7. BlogCard Stretched-Link Pattern — ✅ PASS
- Outer: `<motion.article>` (not `<a>`) ✅
- Stretched link: `after:absolute after:inset-0 z-10` on inner `<a>` ✅
- Tag links: `relative z-20` on container, individual `<a>` tags ✅
- No nested anchors — tags sit above stretched link via z-index ✅

### 8. No File Conflicts — ✅ PASS
11 files changed, all non-overlapping:
```
src/components/About/AboutCard.tsx      (Builder 3 only)
src/components/Blog/BlogCard.tsx        (Builder 5 only)
src/components/Hero/HeroScene.tsx       (Builder 2 only)
src/components/Hero/ScrollIndicator.tsx (Builder 2 only)
src/components/Projects/ProjectCard.tsx (Builder 4 only)
src/components/Projects/ProjectGrid.tsx (Builder 4 only)
src/components/UI/Footer.tsx            (Builder 5 only)
src/layouts/Layout.astro                (Builder 2 only)
src/lib/site.ts                         (Builder 3 only)
src/pages/index.astro                   (Builder 2 only)
src/styles/global.css                   (Builder 1 only)
```

### 9. Reduced-Motion Guards — ✅ PASS

| Component | Guard | Correct |
|-----------|-------|---------|
| HeroScene.tsx:30 | `matchMedia` → return null | ✅ |
| ScrollIndicator.tsx:4 | `matchMedia` → static version | ✅ |
| ProjectCard.tsx:14 | `matchMedia` → empty animationProps | ✅ |
| AboutCard.tsx:86 | `matchMedia` → empty style for tilt | ✅ |
| global.css:115 | `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` kills all animations | ✅ |

### 10. Focus-Visible CSS — ✅ PASS
- global.css:105-114 covers `a, button, input, textarea, select, [tabindex]` with `outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent)` ✅
- ShareButtons.tsx:26 uses `focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-accent/50` — intentional ring variant, no conflict (component-specific override wins) ✅

---

## Verdict: NEEDS FIXES — 2 critical orphaned CSS class references

**Must fix before ship:**
1. `src/pages/index.astro:22` — remove `grid-bg` from hero section class, OR restore `.grid-bg` definition in global.css
2. `src/layouts/Layout.astro:85` — remove `noise-bg` from body class, OR restore `.noise-bg` definition in global.css

**Should fix (cleanup):**
3. Delete `src/components/Hero/HeroTitle.tsx` — dead code, zero imports. Builder 2 should have deleted it.

**Out of scope (music refs):**
4. 6 files still have music/YouTube/KenDaBeatmaker references: about page, CV page, blog index, RSS, structured-data. These were not in any builder's scope.

Otherwise clean — all 5 builders' functional changes verified correct, no regressions, no conflicts.
